entities.name: Santa Rita da Cascia alle Vergini Church
entities.label: Institution
entities.summary: Santa Rita da Cascia alle Vergini is a Roman Catholic church in Rome, sited at the corner of Via delle Vergini and Via dell’Umiltà. Diagonal from the church on Via delle Vergini is the Teatro Quirino.
